verdict.rationale: Slack markets 'Unlimited message history' as a headline pricing-page feature, but hands-on community evidence explicitly confirms the free tier does not retain full history — messages older than a set window (cited as ~90 days/6 months) are hidden ('memory-holed') unless the team upgrades, making history preservation contingent on payment. Missing for 10: any first-party documentation clarifying free-tier retention limits or an admin-facing way to keep full history without upgrading.
